item.text: I’m now building the 2B dossier around Germany’s 2022 conduct in the Russia-Ukraine war: defensive support, restraint, alliance coordination, humanitarian law, peace efforts, and the main criticisms of delay or hesitation. I’m also looking for independent corroboration so the chapter is not dominated by government self-reporting.
